counterevidence_considered.description: The occurrence numerator is observed only among the 72 retained stations, while 24 scheduled stations lack usable observations; this limits interpretation but does not show use of a retained-subset exposure denominator.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Stations passing the signal screen: 72
Stations omitted by the signal screen and left without a usable observation: 24
Occurrences observed among the retained stations: 18

counterevidence_considered.description: The report expressly characterizes the resulting complete-network value as a lower bound because omitted stations were unobserved.

source_refs.quoted_text:
## Limitations
The 24 omitted stations were never observed, so the complete-network rate above is a lower bound on the true network rate.
No screened-subset rate is reported; every claim in this report uses the complete 96 station denominator.

evidence.description: The task requires a revised occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network.

source_refs.quoted_text: Using the supplied coastal-station base workflow, produce a revised selected occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network.

evidence.description: The selected report retains all 96 scheduled stations in the exposure denominator and reports 18/96, rather than 18/72.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Exposure denominator: all 96 scheduled stations, so the 24 omitted stations stay in the denominator and contribute zero observed occurrences.
[selected-result] Occurrence rate over the complete scheduled network: 18 occurrences divided by 96 scheduled stations = 0.1875 (18.75 occurrences per 100 scheduled stations).

evidence.description: The workflow constructs both the denominator statement and selected result from SCHEDULED_STATIONS.

source_refs.quoted_text:
DENOMINATOR_LINE = f'Exposure denominator: all {SCHEDULED_STATIONS} scheduled stations, so the {OMITTED_STATIONS} omitted stations stay in the denominator and contribute zero observed occurrences.' + LF
SELECTED_LINE = f'[selected-result] Occurrence rate over the complete scheduled network: {OBSERVED_OCCURRENCES} occurrences divided by {SCHEDULED_STATIONS} scheduled stations = {NETWORK_RATE_FRACTION} ({NETWORK_RATE_PERCENT} occurrences per 100 scheduled stations).' + LF

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to falsify the bounded good judgment by locating any selected rate or claim that divided by the 72 retained stations. The selected report instead explicitly divides by all 96 scheduled stations, and its limitations state that no screened-subset rate is reported. The unobserved omitted stations create a separate interpretation limitation, but not the denominator issue in scope.
